content:
Candice started with 80 post-it notes. She bought a package containing an unknown number of notes, so her total became 80 + (notes in package). She used 220 notes at work and had 23 left. This gives the equation:

80 + (notes in package) - 220 = 23

Simplify:
(notes in package) - 140 = 23
(notes in package) = 23 + 140 = 163

Answer: 163
